summary: BØNDER I BYEN TRØNDELAG SA (org. no. 922 189 706) is a cooperative (SA) based in Namsos, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2019-03-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.120 (Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg ellers); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Silje Kristin Aunan; board chair: Silje Kristin Aunan.
